title: Deliver & maintain PalletCut (SplitBox) — Dual-Mode UoB bulk-grocery & household-essentials pooling web app
summary: Deliver & maintain PalletCut (formerly SplitBox) — Dual-Mode (zero-config offline Demo Mode + Supabase/Stripe Live Mode) tactile light-mode UoB bulk-grocery & household-essentials pooling web app (1 active launch hub Vale · Shackleton + 3 coming_soon vote hubs, £ GBP integer-pence sequential FCFS case allocation, £0.00 crate fee >= £9.00 / £0.39 < £9.00, Card Pre-Authorisation Hold cutoff settlement, SVG QR + 4-digit PIN pickup pass, and 375px mobile layout).
invariants: Zero External Asset CDNs (Both Modes): Self-hosted @fontsource fonts, local palletcut-*.svg assets, and local qrcode.react SVG; Demo Mode runs 100% offline via localStorage.

UoB Drop #1 Hub & GBP (£) Fee Rules: 1 active launch hub (Vale · Shackleton; 3 other UoB hubs as coming_soon votes), £0.00 fee >= £9.00 (£0.39 micro-crate fee < £9.00), Card Pre-Authorisation Hold copy.
Chronological Sequential Case Allocation: Strictly first-come-first-served across Box #1, Box #2, ... with <100% overflow slices auto-released at Wednesday 23:59 cutoff.

Tactile Citrus-Crate Craft (Kept for Launch): #F7FAF8 light canvas, 1.5px–2px #0B241C borders, 3px 3px 0px #0B241C hard shadows, radial SVG <SliceMeter /> only, #0B241C ink on #10D48E mint & #FF6B1A tangerine.

acceptance_gates.title: Clean TypeScript & Vite Build
acceptance_gates.criteria: tsc -b && vite build exits 0 with zero TypeScript or bundler errors.

acceptance_gates.title: Zero External Network / CDN Calls
acceptance_gates.criteria: 0 external http(s) requests on load and checkout/cutoff flows; local @fontsource, SVGs, and £ GBP copy.

acceptance_gates.title: 3/4 + 2 Cross-Box Allocation & Auto-Refund
acceptance_gates.criteria: Ordering 2 slices at 3/4 records Box #1 (4/4 Locked) + Box #2 (1/4 Pooling -> Auto-Refunded on Trigger Cutoff) with localStorage persistence.

acceptance_gates.title: QR + 4-Digit PIN Net £ Receipt & Reset
acceptance_gates.criteria: Post-cutoff Orders/Pickup Pass displays fulfilled vs. auto-refunded slices, net £ charged total, SVG QR + 4-digit PIN, and working Reset.

acceptance_gates.title: 375px Zero-Overflow Mobile Layout
acceptance_gates.criteria: At 375px x 812px viewport, single-column catalog grid with scrollWidth <= 375 and sticky bottom basket bar.
